page.layout: One page: a blank, stained leaf (the cover or endpaper of the volume). Partly visible at the right edge is a letter fragment of a printed label or spine, not running text. Lower right: a library label with a red border and a digitiser's line of small print, not transcribed.
page.notes: Blank page: no printed text on the leaf itself. Show-through and staining only. At the right edge a fragment of a black letter or bold capital (apparently part of a printed title or spine) is cut off by the scan edge; it is too incomplete to read and is not transcribed. The red-bordered library label, its numbers and the digitiser's line are left out.
